question: The preprocessed EEG is in volts (~2e-5) against spectral features at ~7. Scaling it to unit variance makes the temporal branch numerically live. Does a live temporal branch improve sleep staging?
answer: No - BUT SEE 'SUPERSEDED'. The branch becomes heavily used and accuracy does not improve, WITH THIS ENCODER. With an encoder whose receptive field can contain a spindle, it does.

design.changed: raw EEG multiplied by EEG_SCALE = 15849.46 (1/std, fitted on TRAINING split only)
design.held_constant: architecture, parameters, data, splits, schedule, class weighting, seed 42, epochs
design.note: Selection and comparison use VALIDATION only. The held-out test split was never loaded for these runs.

branch_liveness.method: Replace the ENTIRE raw EEG input with zeros and compare predictions epoch by epoch. Stronger than attribution: deleting an input measures its contribution rather than estimating it.
branch_liveness.conclusion: Normalisation unambiguously revived the branch. Deleting the EEG now changes 25.1% of student predictions and 42.0% of teacher predictions.

performance.convergence: both converged; last-10-epoch macro-F1 range 0.0058 (student) and 0.0060 (teacher)

interpretation.finding: The raw EEG carries no predictive information beyond what the 34 precomputed spectral features already encode.
interpretation.mechanism: The 34 spectral features are COMPUTED FROM the same single-channel EEG. They are not a second modality but a lossy summary of identical data. Giving the model the raw trace as well lets it re-derive information it already had; there is no independent signal to gain, which is what a -0.006 delta looks like.
interpretation.why_slightly_worse: More input dimensions at fixed parameter count spends capacity on redundant reconstruction. Consistent with both models peaking EARLIER (epoch 43 vs 64, 40 vs 51) and then early-stopping.
interpretation.clarifies_earlier_result: The earlier N3/REM collapse when the spectral branch was removed is now sharper: it did not remove one of two inputs, it removed the only usable encoding of the signal.

parameter_breakdown.note: Corrects an earlier claim in commit 4b8b82f that the temporal branch held 'most of the parameters'. It does not.
parameter_breakdown.implication: The inert branch was a dead INPUT PATHWAY, not a large block of wasted capacity. Removing the temporal encoder and the fusion layer would give a spectral-only student of 102,533 params - 6.3x compression against the teacher, against 5.36x now. A modest gain, not the dramatic one first suggested.

decision.reason: The stored un-normalised student remains the best model on validation (0.6881 vs 0.6821) and on held-out test (kappa 0.6449). Its dead temporal branch is now known to cost nothing, because the information it would carry is already in the spectral features.
decision.existing_results_affected: None. These were new files; no existing trainer, tensor or checkpoint was modified, and no published figure changes.

future_work: Spectral-only student: drop temporal_encoder + fusion for 102,533 params at expected parity. Cheap to test and would raise compression to 6.3x.
The transformer is 82-92% of both models and is the real target for compression, not the temporal branch.
A genuinely independent second modality (EOG) would test the fusion hypothesis properly; EEG-derived spectral features cannot, since they share a source.

SUPERSEDED.status: The headline finding below is FALSIFIED. The measurements are correct; the interpretation drawn from them is not.
SUPERSEDED.falsified: interpretation.finding - 'The raw EEG carries no predictive information beyond what the 34 precomputed spectral features already encode.'
SUPERSEDED.why: This experiment varied the input SCALE while holding the ARCHITECTURE fixed. The encoder it measured has a receptive field of 25 samples - 0.25 s at 100 Hz - and then averages all 3000 positions. No sleep spindle, K-complex, slow wave or sawtooth wave fits in 0.25 s. The -0.0060 was evidence about that encoder, not about the EEG.
SUPERSEDED.what_replaced_it: With an 8.75 s receptive field and the same EEG_SCALE, validation macro-F1 went 0.6821 -> 0.7236 (+0.0415), N1 F1 +0.092, and the raw EEG now changes 71.27% of predictions against 25.12% here.
what_still_holds: Every measurement in this file is correct and reproducible.
The temporal branch WAS inert at EEG_SCALE=1 (agreement 1.00000).
The 34 spectral features are computed from the same EEG and are not an independent modality - which is why EOG is the right next input.
The parameter breakdown: the transformer is 82-92% of both models.
SUPERSEDED.lesson: A one-variable A/B is only as informative as the variable it holds fixed. Holding the architecture constant made the architecture invisible.
